title: Scenario analysis
intro: Result distributions depend on the data and assumptions. They are neither forecasts nor suggestions to act.
refreshFailed: Updates are unavailable. Showing the last reading.
role: Heavy analyses are available to pro and admin roles. An administrator assigns the pro role; it is not a paid subscription.
quota: The daily analysis limit has been reached.
renewalUnknown: The exact reset time is unavailable.

previewText: Current snapshot of non-demo accounts. Monte Carlo: stationary bootstrap, average block of 6 months, full history, fixed weights and monthly rebalancing. Goal: contributions indexed to inflation, levels of 50%, 75% and 90%. Stress tests: enabled historical scenarios from the API. Transaction costs are outside the model.
noGoal: No target was set for this analysis.
drawdownText: Drawdown percentiles along return-index paths, excluding deposits and withdrawals. More negative values indicate deeper drawdowns.
howMc: P5 means that 5% of paths end below this value. The P5–P95 band covers the middle 90% of scenarios and P25–P75 the middle 50%. P50: half the scenarios below. Losses outside the displayed band are possible. P(target) is a frequency in the model, not a promise. The fan chart shows market value; target probability accounts for the selected tax model.
howStress: The historical range describes the trough and peak of the path in the selected window. It does not define the worst possible outcome. For a hypothetical shock, the range depends on a beta model or normal distribution. A proxy can hide individual company and liquidity risk; a low share of own history increases this limitation.
howGoal: The amounts form a distribution of the required first monthly contribution for different model probability levels. They are neither contribution recommendations nor a guarantee of reaching the target. The levels depend on assumptions, costs and inflation. An out-of-range result is not a zero contribution.
crisis: Monte Carlo does not show the course of a specific crisis. Historical crisis tests are a separate analysis: stress tests.
assumptions: Data, model, costs, tax and limitations recorded when the analysis was started.
reproduceNote: Reproduction requires the same parameters, seed, algorithm and data. Date ranges do not guarantee that historical data will remain unchanged after corrections.
metadataNote: Historical series metadata was read when the result was saved. It does not describe current quotes. The list includes available metadata; an absent series has no confirmed source or delay.
alreadyMet: The target is already reached in this share of scenarios without additional contributions.
unavailableScenario: Scenario not calculated: insufficient history or data coverage.
chartUnavailable: The chart is unavailable. Full data is in the table.
chartLegend: Outer band P5–P95; inner band P25–P75; P50 line. Horizontal axis: months. Vertical axis: PLN.
unsupported: This analysis type does not have a results screen yet.

warningTemplates.COSTS_NOT_MODELLED: Annual cost is set to 0%: fund fees and currency conversion are omitted, and transaction commissions are outside the model; actual values will be lower.
warningTemplates.TRANSACTION_COSTS_NOT_MODELLED: The annual cost of {value}% (fund fees and currency conversion) is deducted once a year; transaction commissions are outside the model.
warningTemplates.CONCENTRATION_NOT_MODELLED: The largest position is {value}% of the portfolio; index proxies do not capture single-instrument risk, so dispersion is underestimated.
warningTemplates.SHORT_HISTORY: Proxy history covers {value} months (less than 20 years); see the sensitivity table.
warningTemplates.RISK_FREE_MISSING: No NBP reference rate is available; cash earns no interest (assumption).
warningTemplates.MODEL_PROBABILITY: Probabilities describe model scenarios based on proxy history; they are not guarantees. See the sensitivity table.
warningTemplates.GOAL_OUT_OF_RANGE: For some probability levels the model cannot determine a contribution within a reasonable range (no value).
warningTemplates.SEQUENCE_RISK: In {value}% of scenarios withdrawals exhausted the portfolio before the end of the horizon (sequence risk).
warningTemplates.ILLIQUID_SERIES: Some instruments have no trades in more than 20% of sessions in the scenario window; closes may be stale and the decline understated.
warningTemplates.NORMAL_TAILS: The correlation shock uses a normal distribution for one month; crisis tails are heavier, so actual extreme losses can be greater.
warningTemplates.LOW_FACTOR_FIT: The factor explains less than 30% of portfolio variation (R²); a single-factor shock says little about this portfolio.
warningTemplates.LINEAR_SINGLE_FACTOR: Hypothetical shocks assume a linear relationship with one factor over the last 60 months; betas and correlations usually rise in crises.
warningTemplates.HISTORICAL_PATH_NOT_WORST_CASE: A historical scenario applies one past path to current positions; it is not the worst possible outcome, and the next crisis may unfold differently.
warningTemplates.PROXY_SUBSTITUTED: Up to {value}% of position value was calculated using a substitute series (index proxy); the proxy does not capture single-instrument risk.
warningTemplates.PARTIAL_COVERAGE: Some positions have neither scenario-window data nor a proxy; the result covers the supported positions and cash.
warningTemplates.SCENARIO_REFUSED: {value} scenario(s) were omitted: value coverage below 80% or missing factor data (empty fields).
warningTemplates.OWN_SERIES_QUALITY_HOLD: Some instrument series await quality verification; their proxies were used.
warningTemplates.CASH_ZERO_RETURN: Cash does not change value in scenarios (0%, assumption).
